title: Bound pair of two Model D bodies: bound level, curvature, cost and clock rates

key_results.statement: Fibre contract of the pair on the levels $k_1,k_2$, with the phase convention $\eta$: $H(P)=A_1+A_2+M_1\sigma^{(1)}_3+M_2\sigma^{(2)}_3+W(\hat r)$; on plane waves $e^{iqr}$ the part without $W$ is $-\tau_1\sin p_1\,\sigma^{(1)}_1-\tau_2\sin p_2\,\sigma^{(2)}_1+M_1\sigma^{(1)}_3+M_2\sigma^{(2)}_3$ with $p_1=\eta P+q$, $p_2=(1-\eta)P-q$. Class: every binding of $\mathcal W$, all data. Status: exact.

Two-body bands, the same for every $W\in\mathcal W$: $\mathcal B_{\sigma_1\sigma_2}(P)=\{\sigma_1\omega_1(p_1)+\sigma_2\omega_2(P-p_1)\}$; at $P=0$: $\mathcal B_{++}=[M_1+M_2,\Omega_1+\Omega_2]$, $\mathcal B_{+-}=[\min f,\max f]$ with $f(v)=\sqrt{M_1^2+\tau_1^2v}-\sqrt{M_2^2+\tau_2^2v}$ on $[0,1]$, $\mathcal B_{--}=-\mathcal B_{++}$, $\mathcal B_{-+}=-\mathcal B_{+-}$; for equal data $\mathcal B_{\pm\mp}(0)=\{0\}$. Class: $\mathcal W$, all data. Status: exact.

Replacements of the listed terms that leave $C$ unchanged: $\delta C^{\rm D}_1=T_1$, $\delta C^{\rm D}_2=T_2$, $\delta C_{\rm rec}=\alpha+\beta$, $\delta U=-(T_1+\alpha)-(T_2+\beta)$ with single-object operators; the range condition forces $\delta U=0$, and then $\delta C^{\rm D}_1=t-\alpha$, $\delta C^{\rm D}_2=-t-\beta$, $\delta C_{\rm pair}=-(\alpha+\beta)$ with every self-adjoint single-object $\alpha$, $\beta$ and one real $t$; within the stated forms of the question only real constants remain, $\delta C_{\rm pair}=-(c_1+c_2)$. Class: $\mathcal W$. Status: exact.

Well defined (M6), under every replacement (11.3). Computed from $C_{\rm bod}$ of (11.21): $W(r)$ yes, by the range condition; $M_i$ yes as half the gap between the branches, no as a cost of one body; $E_b(P)$ yes as a total cost (1.8) only, no as a cost of the pair; $E_b(P)-(M_1+M_2)$ yes as the distance $E_{\rm bind}(P)$ of (11.22) from the band edge; $E_b(P)-E_b(0)$ yes; $E_b''(0)$ yes; $\langle\sigma^{(i)}_3\rangle_P$ yes (for a degenerate level it depends on the eigenvector). Computed from the listed terms: only $W(r)$ is well defined, and the literal expression $E_b(P)-(M_1+M_2)$ is not well defined. Class: $\mathcal W$. Status: exact.

$\partial E_b/\partial M_i=\langle\sigma^{(i)}_3\rangle_P$, $\tau_i\,\partial E_b/\partial\tau_i=\langle A_i\rangle_P$, $\partial E_b/\partial\theta\vert_{\theta=1}=\langle U\rangle_P$ for $i=1,2$. Class: every binding of $\mathcal W$, all data, every simple bound level, every $P$ of its interval (degenerate levels: (11.23)). Status: exact.

Scaling relation: $E_b(P)=M_1\langle\sigma^{(1)}_3\rangle_P+M_2\langle\sigma^{(2)}_3\rangle_P+\langle A_1\rangle_P+\langle A_2\rangle_P+\langle U\rangle_P$. Class: as (11.5); for a degenerate level it holds for every eigenvector of the level. Status: exact.

$E_b'(P)=\langle V_1\rangle_P=\langle V_2\rangle_P$ with $V_i=i[A_i,\hat x_i]$, the operator of the rate of the position label of the part $i$. Class: every binding of $\mathcal W$, all data, every simple bound level, every $P$ (degenerate levels: (11.23)). Status: exact.

In a state built from the bound level with the weight $\lvert g(P)\rvert^2$ of mean $P_0$ and width $\delta P$: $\mathrm d\bar m_1/\mathrm d\lambda=\mathrm d\bar m_2/\mathrm d\lambda=\int\mathrm dP\,\lvert g\rvert^2E_b'(P)=E_b'(P_0)+O(\delta P^2)$ for every $\lambda$; the two bodies have the same mean velocity. Class: $\mathcal W$, every bound level (a degenerate level: a state built from one branch or from the level where it is $n$-fold, Step 5a), every $g$. Status: exact under $C_{\rm pair}$; the records change it at $O(\kappa)$ for fixed $\lambda$.

$E_b''(P)=-\eta^2\langle A_1\rangle_P-(1-\eta)^2\langle A_2\rangle_P-2\,\mathcal S_\eta(P)$ with $\mathcal S_\eta(P)=\langle V_\eta\psi_P\vert Q_P(H(P)-E_b)^{-1}Q_P\vert V_\eta\psi_P\rangle$, $V_\eta=\eta V_1+(1-\eta)V_2$, a sum over the rest of the spectrum; each part depends on the convention $\eta$, the sum does not. Class: $\mathcal W$, every simple bound level (for a degenerate level it is not defined and (11.24) replaces it). Status: exact.

Bound levels of a diagonal on-site binding: the solutions $E$ outside the bands of $F_+F_-=0$ with $F_+=(1+w_{11}G_{11})(1+w_{22}G_{22})-w_{11}w_{22}g_\times^2$ and $F_-=(1+w_{12}G_{12})(1+w_{21}G_{21})-w_{12}w_{21}g_\times^2$, where $G_{s_1s_2}(E,P)$ and $g_\times(E,P)$ are explicit integrals over the relative label $q$; the factors belong to the sectors of the symmetry $\Xi=(-1)^{\hat r}\sigma^{(1)}_3\sigma^{(2)}_3$. Class: every diagonal on-site binding, all data. Status: exact.

Effective contract near $M_1+M_2$ on the branches $\lvert11\rangle$: $(H_{\rm eff}\psi)(r)=(M_1+M_2+a+w_{11}\delta_{r,0})\psi(r)-\frac12[J\psi(r+2)+J^{*}\psi(r-2)]$ with $J=a_1e^{2i\eta P}+a_2e^{-2i(1-\eta)P}$, $a_i=\tau_i^2/(4M_i)$, $a=a_1+a_2$. Class: every diagonal on-site binding, regime $\mathsf R$. Status: leading order, remainder $O(\epsilon^4)$ in norm against terms $O(\epsilon^2)$.

$E_b(P)=M_1+M_2+a+\varsigma\sqrt{w_{11}^2+j(P)^2}$ with $j(P)^2=a_1^2+a_2^2+2a_1a_2\cos2P$, $\varsigma=\operatorname{sgn}w_{11}$: a bound level at a distance of order $\epsilon^2$ from $\mathcal B_{++}(P)$ exists iff $\hat w_{11}\neq0$, it is exactly one and simple, below the band for $w_{11}<0$ and above it for $w_{11}>0$; of the four numbers only $w_{11}$ enters ($w_{22}$ enters at order $\epsilon^6$, $w_{12}$ and $w_{21}$ at no order). Class: every diagonal on-site binding, regime $\mathsf R$, every $P$. Status: leading order, remainder $O(\epsilon^4)$ against terms $O(\epsilon^2)$.

Bound eigenvector for $j(P)\neq0$: $\psi_P(r)=\mathcal N_Pe^{-i\alpha(P)r/2}\rho(P)^{\lvert r\rvert/2}\lvert11\rangle$ for even $r$ and $0$ for odd $r$, with $\rho=-\varsigma(\sqrt{w_{11}^2+j^2}-\lvert w_{11}\rvert)/j$, $\mathcal N_P^2=\lvert w_{11}\rvert/\sqrt{w_{11}^2+j^2}$, $\alpha=\arg J$; at $j(P)=0$ (only for $a_1=a_2$ at $P=\pm\pi/2$) $\psi_P(r)=\delta_{r,0}\lvert11\rangle$, the limit $\rho\to0$. Class: every diagonal on-site binding, regime $\mathsf R$. Status: leading order, up to $O(\epsilon)$ (branches $\lvert21\rangle$, $\lvert12\rangle$ on odd $r$).

At $P=0$: $E_{\rm bind}=a+\varsigma\sqrt{w_{11}^2+a^2}$, $E_b''(0)=-\varsigma\,4a_1a_2/\sqrt{w_{11}^2+a^2}$, $\langle\sigma^{(i)}_3\rangle_0=1-(a_i/M_i)\Lambda$, $\langle A_i\rangle_0=2a_i\Lambda$, $\langle U\rangle_0=\varsigma\,w_{11}^2/\sqrt{w_{11}^2+a^2}$, with $\Lambda=1+\varsigma/\sqrt{1+u^2}$, $u=\lvert w_{11}\rvert/a$. Class: every diagonal on-site binding, regime $\mathsf R$. Status: leading order, remainders $O(\epsilon^4)$ against terms $O(\epsilon^2)$.

Limits of (11.14). Wide pair ($u\to0$, $w_{11}<0$): $E_{\rm bind}=-w_{11}^2/(2a)$, $E_b''(0)=(4a_1a_2/a)(1-u^2/2)$, $1-\langle\sigma^{(i)}_3\rangle_0=(a_i/M_i)u^2/2$, $\langle A_i\rangle_0=a_iu^2$, $\langle U\rangle_0=-w_{11}^2/a$. Tight pair ($u\to\infty$): $E_{\rm bind}=w_{11}+a+a^2/(2w_{11})$, $E_b''(0)=-4a_1a_2/w_{11}$, $1-\langle\sigma^{(i)}_3\rangle_0=(a_i/M_i)(1+a/w_{11})$, $\langle A_i\rangle_0=2a_i(1+a/w_{11})$, $\langle U\rangle_0=w_{11}-a^2/(2w_{11})$. Class: diagonal on-site binding, regime $\mathsf R$. Status: leading order in $\mathsf R$, relative corrections $O(u^2)$ and $O(u^{-2})$.

$\mathfrak m_b=-\varsigma(\mathfrak m_1+\mathfrak m_2)\sqrt{1+u^2}=\mathfrak m_1+\mathfrak m_2-4\mathfrak m_1\mathfrak m_2E_{\rm bind}$: the difference from $\mathfrak m_1+\mathfrak m_2$ has the sign of $-w_{11}$, and $\mathfrak m_b<0$ for $w_{11}>0$. Class: every diagonal on-site binding with $\hat w_{11}\neq0$, all $\tau_1,\tau_2$, regime $\mathsf R$. Status: leading order, relative remainder $O(\epsilon^2)$.

For $\tau_1=\tau_2=\tau$: $\tau^2\mathfrak m_b=M_1+M_2-(4M_1M_2/\tau^2)E_{\rm bind}$ agrees neither with the cost $M_1+M_2+E_{\rm bind}$ nor with $\sum_iM_i\langle\sigma^{(i)}_3\rangle_0=M_1+M_2-a\Lambda$: the leading difference is $-(4M_1M_2/\tau^2)E_{\rm bind}=(M_1+M_2)(-\varsigma\sqrt{1+u^2}-1)$, of order $\epsilon^0$; the cost and $\sum_iM_i\langle\sigma^{(i)}_3\rangle_0$ differ at order $\epsilon^2$ by $\langle A_1\rangle_0+\langle A_2\rangle_0+\langle U\rangle_0$. Class: diagonal on-site binding, $\tau_1=\tau_2$, regime $\mathsf R$. Status: leading order, remainders $O(\epsilon^2)$.

Control without a binding: the lower edge $e(P)$ of $\mathcal B_{++}(P)$ has $1/e''(0)=\mathfrak m_1+\mathfrak m_2=M_1/\tau_1^2+M_2/\tau_2^2$, $e(0)=M_1+M_2$; for $\tau_1=\tau_2=\tau$, $\tau^2/e''(0)=M_1+M_2$ exactly; for $\tau_1\neq\tau_2$, $\tau_1^2/e''(0)-(M_1+M_2)=M_2(\tau_1^2/\tau_2^2-1)\neq0$. Class: $W=0$, all data. Status: exact.

Reading of the clock label of the part $i$ in a bound level at $P=0$: $q_i(a;\lambda)=P_{N_i}(a;\Gamma_i\lambda/\lambda_{0,i})+\mathcal R_i$ with the rate $\Gamma_i/\lambda_{0,i}$ and the ratio $\Gamma_i=\langle\sigma^{(i)}_3\rangle_0=\partial E_b(0)/\partial M_i\le1$ to the free part at rest, taken at the mean rest cost $\bar M_i=m_i+\bar d_i$, $\bar d_i=\pi(N_i-1)/(N_i\lambda_{0,i})$. Class: every diagonal on-site binding, every bound level at $P=0$ that is simple over the range of the levels of the clock. Status: the rate to first order in the level spacing; the statistics up to $\mathcal R_i=O(\delta_i^2(1+\lambda/\lambda_{0,i})^2)+O(\delta P^2(1+\lambda/\lambda_{0,i}))+O(\kappa)$ with $\delta_i=D_i/g_0$, small for $\lambda\ll\lambda_{0,i}/\delta_i$; the condition $\delta_i\ll1$ is sufficient.

$\Gamma_i=1-\frac{\tau_i^2}{4M_i^2}\Lambda$ with $M_i=\bar M_i$ for the part whose clock is read and the common factor $\Lambda=1+\varsigma/\sqrt{1+u^2}$, so at one pair $(M_1,M_2)$ $(1-\Gamma_1)/(1-\Gamma_2)=(\tau_1/M_1)^2/(\tau_2/M_2)^2$: the clocks of the two parts are not slowed by the same factor unless $\tau_1/M_1=\tau_2/M_2$. Class: every diagonal on-site binding with $\hat w_{11}\neq0$, regime $\mathsf R$. Status: leading order, remainder $O(\epsilon^4)$ against terms $O(\epsilon^2)$.

$C_{\rm bod}:=\langle\chi\vert C\vert\chi\rangle_c=\operatorname{Tr}_c[C(\mathbb 1\otimes\lvert\chi\rangle\langle\chi\rvert)]$, the operator on the two bodies to which every result refers: it is fixed by the total contract $C$ and the start $\chi$ of the medium and is the same in every listing; in the listing of the question it is $C^{\rm D}_1+C^{\rm D}_2+U+\kappa\langle\chi\vert X\vert\chi\rangle(\hat x_1+\hat x_2)$, so under the assumption $\langle\chi\vert X\vert\chi\rangle=0$ it is the listed $C_{\rm pair}$ and commutes with the joint shift. Class: $\mathcal W$, every start $\chi$. Status: exact; the view of the two bodies evolves by it up to second order in the record term.

$E_{\rm bind}(P):=E_b(P)-e_{++}(0)$ with $e_{++}(P)=\min\mathcal B_{++}(P)$, $e_{++}(0)=M_1+M_2$ and $E_{\rm bind}:=E_{\rm bind}(0)$: the distance of the bound level from the band edge, a difference of two total costs, unchanged under every replacement (11.3) and under a constant added to $C$. Class: $\mathcal W$. Status: exact.

Degenerate bound level (multiplicity $n\ge2$, eigenprojector $\Pi_b$): for each parameter $\xi\in\{M_1,M_2,	au_1,	au_2,	heta,P\}$ the derivatives of the $n$ analytic branches are the eigenvalues of $\Pi_b(\partial_\xi H)\Pi_b$ and the branch vectors $\psi^{(
u)}_\xi$ its eigenvectors, so (11.5) and (11.7) hold for the branch vectors of the parameter that is varied; for every unit eigenvector $\psi$ of the level $\langle\psi\vert\partial_\xi H\vert\psiangle=\sum_
u\lvert\langle\psi^{(
u)}_\xi\vert\psianglevert^2\partial_\xi E^{(
u)}$, and (11.6) and $\langle V_1angle=\langle V_2angle$ hold. Class: $\mathcal W$, all data, every degenerate bound level. Status: exact.

Degenerate bound level, branch vector $\psi^{(
u)}_P$ of $P$: $E^{(
u)\prime\prime}(P)=-\eta^2\langle A_1angle_
u-(1-\eta)^2\langle A_2angle_

u)}_P\vert\hat S\vert V_\eta\psi^{(
u)}_Pangle$ with the reduced resolvent $\hat S= ar Q(H(P)-E_b)^{-1} ar Q$, $ ar Q=\mathbb 1-\Pi_b$; for branches with equal first derivatives the second derivatives are the eigenvalues of $\Pi'[\partial_P^2H-2V_\eta\hat SV_\eta]\Pi'$; for $n=1$ it is (11.9). Class: $\mathcal W$, all data, every degenerate bound level. Status: exact.

$\Gamma_i=\Gamma^{(0)}_i+\bar d_i\,\partial^2_{M_i}E_b(0)+O(\delta_i^2)$ with $\Gamma^{(0)}_i=\langle\sigma^{(i)}_3\rangle_0$ at $M_i=m_i$ and $\partial^2_{M_i}E_b(0)=\partial_{M_i}\langle\sigma^{(i)}_3\rangle_0=-2\langle\sigma^{(i)}_3\psi_0\vert Q_0(H(0)-E_b)^{-1}Q_0\vert\sigma^{(i)}_3\psi_0\rangle$: the rate ratio to first order in the level spacing needs the level to second order in the level shift; the level to first order gives only $\Gamma^{(0)}_i$. Class: as (11.19). Status: first order in the level spacing.

$\Gamma_i=1-\frac{\tau_i^2}{4m_i^2}\bigl[\Lambda-\frac{\bar d_i}{m_i}\bigl(2\Lambda+\varsigma\frac{a_i}{a}\frac{u^2}{(1+u^2)^{3/2}}\bigr)\bigr]$ with $a_i$, $a$, $u$, $\Lambda$ at $M_i=m_i$; in $\mathsf R$ the remainder of (11.19) holds with $\delta_i$ replaced by $D_i/M_i$. Class: every diagonal on-site binding with $\hat w_{11}\neq0$, regime $\mathsf R$. Status: leading order in $\mathsf R$ and first order in the level spacing, remainders $O(a_i\bar d_i^2/m_i^3)$ and $O(\epsilon^4)$.

definitions.name: fibre contract of the pair with phase convention eta
operator on the two bodies, defined by the total contract and the start of the medium
binding cost as the distance of the bound level from the band edge
velocity operator of the part i
branches and branch vectors of a parameter at a degenerate bound level
reduced resolvent of a bound level
branch and separation parity of a diagonal on-site binding
second-order hopping scales of the upper branch
binding ratio (wide pair: u small, tight pair: u large)
common factor of the slowing of the two clocks
spread, mean and mean rest cost of the clock levels of the part i
rate ratio of the clock of the part i in the bound pair, at the mean rest cost
rate ratio at zeroth order in the level spacing

open_issues: Whether the curvature inertia of the pair is its inertia in a response to a gradient is not derived here (not asked); (11.17) shows that it is not the cost divided by τ².
Outside the order asked in item 3(b): bound levels closer than O(ε⁴) to the band (for vanishing w₁₁, and in the sector Ξ = −1) are neither established nor excluded.
The coefficients of the O(ε⁴) remainders are not derived; the code only confirms their order.

(11.19) is derived for a bound level that stays simple over the range of the levels of the clock; the condition that the spread of the levels is much smaller than the isolation g₀ is sufficient, and in the regime R, where g₀ is of order ε², it is replaced by a spread much smaller than the rest cost; item 5 for a level that is degenerate at some rest cost in that range is not derived.

The results refer to the operator (11.21) under the assumption that the mean of X in the start of the medium vanishes; without it they hold at leading order in κ only, and the uniform gradient that then appears is a position-dependent term and is not treated (out of scope).

The bound level is well defined only as a total cost of the given contract; whether the zero of the total cost has any content (a constant in the contract changes no reading) is not a question of this package.

consistency_checks.check: Dimensions: τ, M, w, a, j, E_b, E_b'' are costs; u, ρ, Λ, ⟨σ₃⟩, Γ_i are numbers; the curvature inertia is an inverse cost on both sides of (11.16); the spread and the mean of the clock levels and g₀ are costs, δ_i and the first-order term of (11.25) are numbers.
No binding (w₁₁ → 0⁻): (11.12) tends to the lower edge of the band, E_b''(0) to 1/(m₁+m₂) as in (11.18), ⟨σ₃⟩ to 1, ⟨A_i⟩ and ⟨U⟩ to 0, Γ_i to 1.
Scaling relation (11.6) evaluated on the closed forms (11.14) reproduces E_b(0) of (11.12).
